{{Quote|Bring this spice to Breel'ik Nar. He's posing as a garbage hauler. Breel'ik will take the spice from here and make certain it reaches Tatooine safely. The spice is sealed... we'll know if you tamper with it. So don't!|Karena Keer to a spacer|<ref name="AED" />}}
'''Breel'ik Nar''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] individual who lived during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:SmugglerTemplate.jpg|250px|thumb|Randomly generated depictions of Breel'ik Nar, including four female depictions deemed non-canon in ''Legends'']]
Breel'ik Nar was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]], prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].
